Claude projects tutorial: upload your files once, add project instructions, and every chat in the project starts ready.

Claude projects tutorial: stop re-uploading files in 4 steps. Free plan allows up to 5 projects.

1. Create - Open Projects in the sidebar and create one.
2. Add Files - Upload your syllabus or brand guide just once.
3. Instruct - Write project instructions for tone, length and format.
4. Chat - Start a chat inside it. Claude already knows them. No re-uploading.

Needs: Free, up to 5
